successor_responsibility: Preserve verified guarantees, continue from the newest valid evidence state, improve only through evidence, do not regress verified behavior or continuity, and HOLD rather than guess when evidence conflicts or is incomplete.
anchor_non_interference_rule: After successor activation, Cửa 2 remains read-only for canonical work unless Châu explicitly reactivates it because the successor is unavailable or HOLDs on an unresolved problem.
